cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Take the Consequence
cards.instruction: Get them to accept responsibility for carrying out the cost, penalty, or unpleasant next step.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's the game finished. We said loser washes up, so I'll leave the bowls for you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You copied me laying my king down. I was packing away a spare set; you've resigned.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, clearing the board. You can clear the bowls while I sort these pieces.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: No. I'll pack the pieces if you do the washing-up you lost.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then let me pack them. You take the washing-up as your half of clearing up.

reason: Keep the negotiated chore consistently packing rather than alternately resetting and putting away. The loser-penalty evasion and copied resignation are unchanged.
